source_caption:
The exact moment Emma stone chose violence ; ) 

La La Land is a cinematic love letter to dreamers, but this scene is where the magic actually starts. Sebastian (Ryan Gosling) is stuck in a 1980s cover band, playing a keytar at a pool party, when Mia (Emma Stone) spots him. Instead of being nice, she decides to humiliate him by requesting "I Ran" by A Flock of Seagulls forcing a "serious" jazz musician to play synth-pop. It’s the perfect blend of petty and charming.
